lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in roughly seven visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, showing a semi-regular grid distribution across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, forming a structured rectangular lattice patterning.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient (light upper edge, shadowed lower edge).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: An elongated, high-luminance feature consistent with an attached remora is visible on the mid-distal surface of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region displays a high-density, stochastic distribution of small, lower-intensity spots that transition into the organized grid pattern of the mid-body.
